items.desc_now: China facts your agent can trust: mainland reachability tested from a real backbone (+ live README badge), statutory holidays including make-up workdays, offline ID/phone validation, lunar calendar.
Standing jobs for your agent: hand a recurring check (page changes, China reachability) to a hosted runner — your terminal can close, and you are notified only when the result actually changes.
Messy CSV in, checkable table out: dedupe, merge, reshape, diff two tables on a key, reconcile ledgers in integer cents — every count carries an in-code arithmetic proof.
Ship what humans asked for: markdown to docx/pptx/pdf/epub, and PDFs merged, split, rotated or watermarked — one hosted call each, no local toolchain.
Adversarial review for code, MCP configs and system prompts: every finding carries a repro path and confidence, and anything unreproducible is marked suspected rather than presented as confirmed.
Interrogate a product idea instead of praising it: YC-style six forcing questions, a multi-persona panel allowed to disagree, and the narrowest two-week wedge with a numeric pass/fail test.
